name: Single agent
summary: One model runs one loop with all the tools and the full context, and never delegates. Every decision is made with the same history, which keeps behaviour consistent and easy to debug. It is the default starting point; split into several agents only when one agent clearly struggles.
facts: Every action sees the full context and earlier decisions
Long tasks fill the context window; no parallelism
Lowest token use of the multi-agent options
how: Give one agent the task, the tools and the instructions
Let it loop: think, call a tool, read the result
Compact or summarise history when the context fills up
Stop when the task is done or a human is needed
goodFor: Most tasks, as a first design
Work where decisions depend on each other
watchOut: Too many tools can make tool choice worse
Context grows without bound on long tasks
